description: Use when an agent needs a one-call crypto market snapshot before acting. Input: none. Output: JSON one-line summary; BTC, ETH, SOL price, 24 h change, funding APR, OI, volume; Crypto Fear & Greed value, label, 1 d/7 d change with attribution; OI-weighted perp funding with highest/lowest markets; onchain stablecoin supply and 24 h/7 d net mint or burn. Example: /v1/crypto/pulse Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: crypto_pulse
title: Crypto market pulse: BTC/ETH/SOL price, Fear & Greed, perp funding and stablecoin flows in one call
